title: teclea fischeri
intro: Teclea fischeri, commonly known as the African Pear, is a plant species that belongs to the Rutaceae family. The health benefits of Teclea fischeri include its ability to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an analgesic, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Teclea fischeri include limonoids, coumarins, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
